spec.query:
v = from(bucket: "mini_project")
  |> range(start: -30d, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic_ml_6610301004" and r.field_id == "6610301004")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lane_mode)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lane_3_vehicle_count" or r._field == "lane_3_wrong_way_count")
  |> group(columns: ["lane_mode", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["lane_mode"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      rate: if exists r.lane_3_vehicle_count and r.lane_3_vehicle_count > 0 and exists r.lane_3_wrong_way_count then float(v: r.lane_3_wrong_way_count) / float(v: r.lane_3_vehicle_count) * 100.0 else 0.0
    }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["lane_mode"], valueColumn: "rate")

t1 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "2/2 (%)", _value: if exists r["2_2"] then r["2_2"] else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
t2 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "3/1 (%)", _value: if exists r["3_1"] then r["3_1"] else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
t3 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "สูงกว่า (%)", _value: if exists r["2_2"] and exists r["3_1"] and r["2_2"] > 0.0 then ((r["3_1"] / r["2_2"]) - 1.0) * 100.0 else if exists r["3_1"] and r["3_1"] > 0.0 then 100.0 else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

union(tables: [t1, t2, t3])

spec.title: รูปแบบเลนปัจจุบัน (พร้อมประวัติ)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic_6610301004" and r.field_id == "6610301004")

l1 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "เลน 1", _value: if exists r.lane_1_vehicle_count and r.lane_1_vehicle_count > 0 then float(v: if exists r.lane_1_wrong_way_count then r.lane_1_wrong_way_count else 0) / float(v: r.lane_1_vehicle_count) * 100.0 else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
l2 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "เลน 2", _value: if exists r.lane_2_vehicle_count and r.lane_2_vehicle_count > 0 then float(v: if exists r.lane_2_wrong_way_count then r.lane_2_wrong_way_count else 0) / float(v: r.lane_2_vehicle_count) * 100.0 else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
l3 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "เลน 3", _value: if exists r.lane_3_vehicle_count and r.lane_3_vehicle_count > 0 then float(v: if exists r.lane_3_wrong_way_count then r.lane_3_wrong_way_count else 0) / float(v: r.lane_3_vehicle_count) * 100.0 else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
l4 = v |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "เลน 4", _value: if exists r.lane_4_vehicle_count and r.lane_4_vehicle_count > 0 then float(v: if exists r.lane_4_wrong_way_count then r.lane_4_wrong_way_count else 0) / float(v: r.lane_4_vehicle_count) * 100.0 else 0.0 })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

union(tables: [l1, l2, l3, l4])
